transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Well, I’m here because... for months now, I’ve been noticing a very specific pattern in my work project files. I work as a translator, and certain subcontractors—along with one colleague in particular—keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory and the file timestamps. It’s done so it looks like my quality control failed. I've brought it up, and even when IT says the audit trail is clean... I know what I'm looking at. The record has clearly been arranged to put the blame on me.
Outside of these work-related concerns, have you had any other situations where you felt like others were acting against you or that things were being done to trick or harm you?

No, not at all. It's really just... just at work. Outside of my job, everything is perfectly fine. I don't have any issues with my friends or family, and nobody is trying to trick me in my personal life. It's specifically this situation with the project files and those subcontractors. That's the only thing going on.

Even though IT has told you the audit trail is clean, you still believe the files have been altered to make it look like your quality control failed. Is that something you just can't shake, even though others are telling you there’s no evidence, or do you think it's possible you might be misunderstanding what's happening?

I know how it sounds, and I get why you'd ask if I'm just misunderstanding things. But... no, I can't just shake it off, because I know what I'm looking at. 

Like I mentioned earlier, I've been seeing this exact same pattern for months now. I know my job, and I know how translation memory works. When I see those tiny changes to the files and the timestamps, it's obvious to me that those subcontractors and that one colleague are the ones making them. IT might look at the audit trail and say it's clean, but to me, that just means the record was carefully arranged to cover their tracks. I'm not misunderstanding the situation at all. They are definitely doing this to put the blame on me and make it look like my quality control failed.
Have you ever had experiences where you saw, heard, or felt things that others around you didn’t, or do you believe things to be true that others don’t seem to understand or agree with?

No, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, if that's what you mean. I don't have any hallucinations or anything like that. And as for believing things others don't... well, just what we've been talking about. My colleague and the subcontractors altering the files. People at work might not agree with me or understand what I'm seeing, but that's because they aren't looking at the translation memory the way I am, or they just trust the IT audit. Other than that specific work issue, no, I don't have any strange beliefs or experiences.

Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others find unusual or hard to believe, even when there's no clear reason for them, or have you experienced periods where your mood was significantly low or elevated along with these concerns at work?

No, I haven't had any other unusual thoughts or beliefs. It's really just the situation at work with the files. And as for my mood... I mean, I'm stressed, obviously, because of what's happening with my job and feeling like I'm being set up. It's frustrating. But I haven't had any extreme highs or lows, like being super depressed or overly energetic. I'm just dealing with the stress of the situation, that's all.
Have you ever experienced a time when your mood was unusually high, overly irritable, or you felt extremely energetic for a period of several days or more?

No, I haven't. I've never had anything like that. Like I said, I've just been feeling stressed and frustrated because of the situation at work. But I've never had a time where I felt unusually high, or super energetic, or really irritable for days on end. My mood has been pretty steady, just... you know, under a lot of pressure right now.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that others didn’t share and couldn’t be explained by a real-life situation, even when there was no clear reason for you to think that way?

No, not really. I mean, I think I already answered this, but no. I don't have any strange beliefs or suspicions outside of what's happening at the office. Everything I'm dealing with is tied to a very real situation with the translation memory files and my colleague. There's nothing else going on that doesn't have a clear, real-world explanation.

Do you ever feel like there’s a hidden meaning or special significance in the way the files are being altered that others wouldn’t understand, or that goes beyond just someone trying to shift blame at work?

No, I don't think there's any hidden meaning or anything like that. It's really just a straightforward issue of someone trying to sabotage my work. They're altering the translation memory files so that my output looks bad, which makes me look incompetent to the project managers. That's all it is. There's no special significance or secret message behind it. It's just office politics and someone trying to get ahead by making me look bad.
Have you ever had any other beliefs or suspicions in the past that turned out to be completely unfounded, but you were absolutely sure were true at the time?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've always been a pretty rational person. I don't just jump to conclusions or imagine things that aren't there. If I suspect something, it's because there's evidence right in front of me, like with these files. So, no, I've never had a situation where I was absolutely convinced of something that turned out to be completely made up.

Have you ever had any other experiences where you strongly believed something was being done against you, even when others couldn't see it or confirm it, outside of this situation with the files at work?

No, I haven't. Like I said, this is the only thing. I don't go around thinking people are out to get me. It's just this one specific situation at the office with the translation memory files. That's it. I've never had any other issues like this before.

Even though IT has checked the audit trail and found no evidence of tampering, and no one else shares your belief, do you still feel absolutely certain that the files are being altered to frame you, with no room for doubt?

Yes, I am. I mean, I know what IT says, but for months now I’ve been seeing the exact same pattern in the project files. Certain subcontractors and one colleague in particular keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory and the timestamps. They do it specifically so it looks like my quality control failed. So, even when IT tells me the audit trail is completely clean, it doesn't change what I see. I know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. I don't have any doubt about it.

Even though there is no objective evidence that the files have been altered to frame you, do you still believe, without any doubt, that this is happening and that no one else can see it because they are not looking closely enough or are intentionally ignoring it?

Yes. Like I just said, I don't have any doubt at all. I know IT thinks the audit trail is clean, but that's just because the record has been carefully arranged to hide what they're doing and put the blame on me. 

I've been looking at this exact same pattern in the project files for months now. If other people can't see it, it's because they just aren't looking closely enough. They run a standard check, see what looks normal on the surface, and move on. But I'm the one reviewing the translation memory, and I see the tiny changes to the text and the timestamps. I know what I'm seeing. That colleague and those subcontractors are definitely altering things so it looks like my quality control failed, and I'm absolutely certain of it.
